hero.title: FCC Chair Slams Media Over Stephen Colbert ‘Censorship’ Claim as Texas Senate Race Heats Up
hero.intro: The FCC criticizes media coverage of Stephen Colbert’s alleged CBS censorship as equal time rules resurface, boosting a Texas Senate candidate and intensifying 2026 election tensions.
hero.author: Emily Rodriguez
hero.contentLeft: The controversy highlights how politics, the media, and the federal government are increasingly at odds during an election cycle.
hero.contentRight:
The interview eventually received millions of views on YouTube and helped a Texas Senate campaign raise millions in 24 hours.

The FCC is keeping a closer eye on political guests on talk and entertainment shows.
